name: better-code-review-graph
description: Knowledge graph for token-efficient code reviews -- semantic search and call-graph resolution across your codebase.

EMBEDDING_MODELS.title: Embedding model selection (optional)
EMBEDDING_MODELS.description: CSV 'provider/model,...'; selects the first entry without runtime fallback. Empty = local fastretrieval registry. Example: cohere/embed-v4.0 (paid; exact 1024 dimensions).

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL.title: Local embedding model (optional)
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Built-in fastretrieval model ID, or a local directory containing fastretrieval-manifest.json. External IDs require LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.

LOCAL_RERANK_MODEL.title: Local reranker model (optional)
LOCAL_RERANK_MODEL.description: Fastretrieval TextCrossEncoder model ID; empty = reranking disabled.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.title: Local embedding dimension
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_DIM.description: Required output dimension for an external LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL ID without a manifest.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_FILE.title: Local embedding model file
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_FILE.description: ONNX file path inside a manifest-backed local artifact directory.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_POOLING.title: Local embedding pooling
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_POOLING.description: Explicit pooling for an external ID without a manifest: CLS, MEAN, LAST_TOKEN, or DISABLED.

LOCAL_EMBEDDING_NORMALIZE.title: Normalize local embeddings
LOCAL_EMBEDDING_NORMALIZE.description: Apply explicit L2 normalization for an external ID without a manifest.

HULL_EMBED_API_KEY.title: Embedding cell API key (optional)
HULL_EMBED_API_KEY.description: Host-injected key for the [models.embed] cell transport (OpenRouter pre-wired default); overrides the cell api_key. Model name still comes from EMBEDDING_MODELS.

HULL_CHAT_API_KEY.title: Chat cell API key (optional)
HULL_CHAT_API_KEY.description: Host-injected key for the [models.chat] cell transport (OpenRouter pre-wired default); enables LLM summaries when the cell model is set.
